extracted.name: Roasted Cherry Tomatoes
extracted.description: These roasted cherry tomatoes are baked with olive oil and balsamic vinegar. They’re deliciously sweet and juicy with perfect caramelized edges.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Whisk olive oil, balsamic vinegar, salt, and pepper together in a large bowl until well combined. Add cherry tomatoes; toss to coat. Spread in an even layer on a rimmed baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven until tender and caramelized, about 30 to 35 minutes.
